proposed_ledger_entry: Item 313 proves the missing Item-311 divisor implication for the actual arithmetic-progression continuant seed: for n>=5 and 1<=k<n-2, Dhat_k>2q_(n-2)Q_k implies Dhat_k does not divide q_(n-1). A rational Legendre descent turns a hypothetical branch into aHY=V C Theta. Exact transfer-matrix induction gives v2(q_(j+L)-q_j)=v2(L)+1 and v2(C Theta-HY)=v2(L) after an exact mod-8 bridge forces 4|L, contradicting (a-V)HY=V(C Theta-HY). Together with Item 311 and the exact n=2,3,4 bases, this proves only R_actual>=q_(n-1)/(2q_(n-2)); the centered half-bound R_actual>=q_(n-1)/2 and the intermediate window remain open. Booking and capacity reduction are zero.
